name: SenseVoice-Small (INT8)
description: Alibaba Tongyi / FunAudioLLM multilingual non-autoregressive speech foundation model, exported to INT8 ONNX by sherpa-onnx. Emits native punctuation and inverse text normalization (ITN) at ~70x real-time factor (~60ms latency on Apple Silicon) with zero traditional-Chinese leakage.

benchmark.host: Apple M4 Pro (arm64), sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 CLI, 8 threads
benchmark.notes: Measured through the shipped runtime path (the sherpa-onnx-offline subprocess Tuff spawns), not through a resident recognizer: 0.43 s wall for a 4.20 s Mandarin utterance, RTF 0.102, with native punctuation and '甚至出现交易几乎停滞的情况。' matching the reference exactly. Two thirds of that wall time is process start plus 229 MB INT8 model load, which every invocation pays again; warm whisper-cli on the same audio and host costs 0.26-0.29 s. The same weights already loaded measure 0.06 s (RTF 0.014) in an in-process harness, which is the headroom a resident recognizer would recover, and which this runtime does not yet reach. Compared with whisper-base, the win here is accuracy (7.7% CER there) and native punctuation/ITN rather than latency.
